# `/capabilities` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /capabilities/v1

`listCapabilitiesV1` — List capabilities — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a list of capabilities. Source sub-admins only see capabilities on the sources they manage. When Machine Identity Security is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `404`. When the capabilities API is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `403`.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: name: eq, in, sw; nativeIdentity: eq, in, sw; type: eq, in; environment: eq, in; datasetId: eq, in; resource.id: eq, in; source.id: eq, in; source.name: eq, in, sw; owners.primary.id: eq, in; owners.primary.name: eq, in, sw; owners.primaryIdentity.id: eq, in; owners.primaryIdentity.name: eq, in, sw; owners.secondaryIdentity.id: eq, in; owners.secondaryIdentity.name: eq, in, sw; owners.secondaryGovernanceGroup.id: eq, in; owners.secondaryGovernanceGroup.name: eq, in, sw; owners.governanceGroup.id: eq, in; owners.governanceGroup.name: eq, in, sw; created: gt, ge, lt, le; modified: gt, ge, lt, le — e.g. `type eq "MCP"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: created, modified, name, type, source.id, source.name, resource.id, environment, datasetId, nativeIdentity, owners.primary.id, owners.primary.name, owners.primaryIdentity.id, owners.primaryIdentity.name, owners.secondaryIdentity.id, owners.secondaryIdentity.name, owners.secondaryGovernanceGroup.id, owners.secondaryGovernanceGroup.name, owners.governanceGroup.id, owners.governanceGroup.name — e.g. `name`
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of capability

### GET /capabilities/v1/{id}

`getCapabilityV1` — Get capability — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a single capability by its ID. The ID must be a UUID; any other value returns `400`. When no capability exists for the ID, this API returns `404`. When Machine Identity Security is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `404`. When the capabilities API is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `403`.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Capability ID.
- Returns 200: capability

### PATCH /capabilities/v1/{id}

`updateCapabilityV1` — Partial update of capability — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to update a capability using a JSON Patch payload. Patchable fields are **description**, **environment**, and **owners**. A patch that targets any other field, including the values discovered from the source, returns `400`. `owners.primary` is a single IDENTITY reference. `owners.secondary` holds either up to ten IDENTITY references or exactly one GOVERNANCE_GROUP reference, not both; any other combination returns `400`. The ID must be a UUID; any other value returns `400`. When…

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Capability ID.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: capability
